hero_kpi_rationale: Comparable sales are the primary growth driver for Walmart, directly measuring demand in existing stores and through digital channels, and represent the most closely watched KPI for omnichannel retailers like Walmart.

kpis.explanation_en: Growth in sales from stores open for more than one year, including online sales.
kpis.description: Walmart U.S. comparable sales increased by 4.3% in 2026, driven by average ticket size and transaction count, with strong e-commerce contribution.

kpis.explanation_en: E-commerce's share in comparable sales growth, including online orders and in-store pickups.
kpis.description: E-commerce contributed 4.3 percentage points to Walmart U.S. comparable sales growth in 2026, up from 2.9 points in 2025, driven by strong Walmart+ member loyalty.

kpis.explanation_en: Percentage of sales remaining after deducting cost of goods sold.
kpis.description: Gross margin improved by 8 basis points in 2026, supported by disciplined inventory management and growth in higher-margin businesses.

kpis.explanation_en: Operating profit divided by net sales, measuring cost efficiency.
kpis.description: Operating margin declined by 13 basis points in 2026 due to higher insurance claims and depreciation costs.
kpis.signal: Pressure on overheads despite sales growth.

kpis.explanation_en: Total revenue after deduction of returns and discounts.
kpis.description: Net sales reached $706.4 billion in 2026, up 4.7% from 2025, supported by comparable sales and omnichannel expansion.
kpis.signal: Solid growth in a context of moderate inflation.

kpis.explanation_en: Profit before interest and taxes, after deduction of all operating expenses.
kpis.description: Operating income amounted to $29.8 billion in 2026, a slight increase from $29.3 billion in 2025.

kpis.explanation_en: Sales growth from clubs open for more than one year, including e-commerce.
kpis.description: Sam's Club U.S. comparable sales increased by 2.9% in 2026, down from 4.7% in 2025, due to weaker fuel sales.

kpis.explanation_en: Contribution of digital sales to Sam's Club comparable sales growth.
kpis.description: E-commerce contributed 3.3 percentage points to Sam's Club comparable sales growth in 2026, up from 2.3 points in 2025.
kpis.signal: Acceleration in digital membership despite overall slowdown.
